verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state the Customer Agent 'works as a team member in Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon' and can also run standalone via API 'instead of a ticketing system,' with shared tool connections and context across both modes. This directly matches the story's dual-mode integration/standalone requirement. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of real bidirectional ticket sync (only vendor docs), and Salesforce is not listed among supported ticketing systems.
